Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

IS: 10694 (Part 7)- 1983 



Indian Standard 



( Reaffirmed 2001 ) 




GENERAL REQUIREMENTS FOR 
RIMS FOR AUTOMOTIVE VEHICLES 

PART 7 INDUSTRIAL TRUCK RIMS 



1. Scope — Covers the rim contours and general requirements for industrial truck rims. 

2. Dimensions — Rim contours for industrial trucks with dimensions shall be as given in Fig. 1 to 4. 

3. Designation — The sizes designation of wheel/rims shall include figures and alphabets in the 
following order, representing: 

a) nominal rim width code. 

b) rim flange profile, and 

c) nominal rim diameter code. 

3.1 An alphabet signifies the tyre side profile of the rim flange. Usually the profile designation follows 
the nominal rim width code. It may, however, precede or include the nominal rim width. 

Example: 

4 00 EX 9; and 
5C0SX 12. 

4. Rim Circumference Measurements — The bead seat rim circumference measurements shall be 
carried out by using a tape gauge whose length is related to a mandrel diamater which is that of the 
specified rim diameter. The details of tape mandrel are given in Fig 1 to 4. 

5. Genera! Requirements — The rim shall have a smooth contour free from sharp edges on the tyre 

side. 

5.1 Valve hole edges on rim shall be free from burrs. 



-*4— 7-9 mm.

EXPLA N ATOR Y NOTE 

Wheels/rims for all types of vehic'es are being manufactured in the country. This Indian 
Standard has been issued in order that the manufacturers follow the uniform rim profiles for proper 
fitment of tyres and become familiar with the size designations and other markings. 

This standard ( Part 7 ) is one of a series of Indian Standards pertaining to rims for various types 
of automotive vehicles; the standards in this series are: 

a) IS : 10694 ( Part 1 ) - 1984 Genera! requirements for rims for automotive vehicles; Part 1 Rim 
nomenclature, designation, marking and measurements 

b) IS : 10694 ( Part 2 )- 1933 General requirements for rims for automotive vehicles: Part 2 
Passenger car rims 

c) IS : 10694 ( Part 3) - 1983 General requirements for rims for automotive vehicles: Part 3 
Commercial vehicle rims 

d) IS : 10694 ( Part 4) - 1983 General requirements for rims for automotive vehicles: Part 4 
Scooter and scooter derivative rims 

e) IS : 10694 ( Part 5) - 1983 General requirements for rims for automotive vehicles: Parts 
Motorcycle and motorcycle derivative rims 

f) IS : 10694 ( Part 6) - 1984 General requirements for rims for automotive vehicles: Part 6 
Agricultural tractor rims 

g) IS : 1C694 ( Part 7) - 1983 General requirements for rims for automotive vehicles: Part 7 
Industrial truck rims 

h) IS : 10694 ( Part 8) - 1983 General requirements for rims for automotive vehicles: Part 3 
Earthmoving machine rims 

Keeping the exports of vehicles in view and for harmonization of standards, efforts have been 
made to refer to ( ETRTO ) European Tyre and Rim Technical Organization standards. 

These standards do not lay down methods of testing and performance requirements for wheels/ 
rim pertaining to the respective types of automotive vehicles but lay down only the rim profiles and other 
general requirements. For passenger car wheels and truck and bus wheels/rims reference may be made 
to the following standards for methods of testing and performance requirements: 

a) IS : 9436 - 1980 Performance requirements and methods of test for wheels for passenger cars. 

b) IS : 9433 - 1980 Performance requirements and methods of test for wheels/rims for trucks and 
buses.
